I.

On the Work

Four years inside the headset. Fifty calls a day — each one a small chance to be useful, to listen well, and leave the customer steadier than I found them.

I am a Customer Service Specialist with 4+ years supporting US-based customers in high-volume BPO environments. As a Subject Matter Expert at Moder Solutions, I lead onboarding for new representatives, certify calls, and resolve escalations — holding 90%+ QA, CSAT, and FCR through it all.

The work is simple; doing it well, day after day, is the discipline.
